items.title: Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China
items.summary: Megaspeed, the firm owned by ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's former lover Alice Huang, arranged nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for Chinese companies between 2024 and 2025, according to the WSJ. Short seller Culper Research estimates Nvidia's actual China revenue share exceeds 20 percent, far above the officially reported 7 percent. The article Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China appeared first on The Decoder .
items.so_what: Este escándalo revela posibles mecanismos para eludir los controles de exportación a China y sugiere una cuota de mercado real de Nvidia en China superior a la oficial, con implicaciones geopolíticas y comerciales.

items.title: After Jensen: A Window for Nvidia’s Rivals, a Problem for Its Suppliers
items.summary: On November 12, Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang had resigned as president, CEO, and director, effective immediately.
